title: Glowing orb UFOs at Pyramid Kuromanta shown in old paintings

tellings.quote: There is a phenomenon that occurs at Pyramid Coramanta that's been shown in ancient paintings of these glowing balls

plain: At Kuromanta, a hill in Akita, Japan that some call a pyramid, glowing balls of light are said to appear, and old Japanese paintings are said to show them. The ancient-sites researcher Geoffrey Drumm tells this from his own research, without naming a particular painting. If true, it would mean the lights have been seen at the site for centuries.
